# Santiago Correa - Senior Frontend Engineer

## Summary
Senior frontend engineer with 9+ years building consumer-facing web products at scale.
Based in Berlin. Currently at Statista as Senior Frontend Engineer, owning registration
and personalization flows for 1M+ monthly users. Previously founding frontend engineer
at Deep Neuron Lab, building two AI-powered SaaS products from scratch.

Latency, accessibility, and how something feels under real-world conditions are not
afterthoughts. They are the work.

## Stack
- **Primary**: React, Remix, TypeScript, Node.js
- **Testing**: Vitest, Playwright
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion
- **3D/Creative**: Three.js, React Three Fiber
- **AI/Backend**: Anthropic API (Claude), Python, FastAPI, Flask, Groq, Whisper
- **Infra**: AWS CDK, Docker, Fly.io, Datadog

## Work Experience
- Statista (Jan 2024 - Present, Berlin) — Senior Frontend Engineer. Registration and personalization team, 1M+ monthly users, Node.js/Remix backend API, Datadog monitoring.
- Deep Neuron Lab (May 2021 - Jan 2024, Berlin) — Frontend Engineer. Founding FE on ai/checklist and ai/numbers, AI-powered audit tools for financial and ESG compliance.
- Globant (Dec 2020 - May 2021) — Frontend Engineer. Stock trading app modernization, Vue.js, 10+ developers.
- ADK Group (Aug 2019 - Dec 2020) — Frontend Developer. 10+ client websites.
- CloudTask (Mar 2019 - Dec 2020) — Lead Frontend Developer.

## Featured Projects

### Cortex (2026, in progress)
Personal AI trained on my own data. Voice capture via Whisper, fast inference via Groq,
vector search via MongoDB Atlas. Building a second brain that knows how I think.
Tech: Python, Groq, Whisper, Hugging Face, MongoDB

### Dispatch (2025 - Present)
Daily AI newsletter powered by the Anthropic API. Claude Haiku 4.5 handles high-volume
source ingestion and initial scoring across hundreds of daily publications. Claude Sonnet
4.6 makes the editorial quality decisions. Human judgment makes the final call before
every send.
URL: https://deliver-ai.xyz/
Tech: Anthropic API, Claude Haiku 4.5, Claude Sonnet 4.6, TypeScript, Node.js

### Statista (2024 - Present)
Registration and personalization platform serving 1M+ monthly users. Built the team's
first backend API in Node.js/Remix for persistent user personalization.
URL: https://www.statista.com/

### Deep Neuron Lab (2021 - 2024)
Two AI-powered SaaS products for financial and ESG compliance audit. Real-time
collaboration, AI-driven suggestions, role-based access, cross-document verification.
URL: https://www.dnl.ai
